messages:
Maya Chen: kicking off a tidy-up PR for the 'First Run' tutorial — aim to: 1) swap in a CLI-first auth snippet, 2) add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ about 401s, 3) replace the old model alias, and 4) fix a bad anchor in the deploy section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899
Devon Li: Nice. Can you keep the env var example but move it under 'advanced' so beginners see the CLI path first?
Maya Chen: yep — plan is: top-level CLI example `redwood auth login` then below a collapsible "env var" block with `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...`.
Sam Ortiz: Heads up — the SDK snippet in Python uses `client = RedwoodClient()` without passing region. We should show the region option for EU customers.
Maya Chen: good catch. I'll add `RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")` as the short callout.
Priya (Docs): Also please add a 1-liner about token scoping for free keys vs org keys. Too many folks assume the same token works across accounts.
Maya Chen: added a migration note about model alias rename from `redwood/helium-v1` -> `redwood/helium` and a sample `sed` one-liner to help CI: `sed -i 's/helium-v1/helium/g' $(git grep -l "helium-v1")`
Devon Li: Could we avoid `sed -i` portability issues on macOS? Maybe show `perl -pi -e` second example or recommend `git grep` + editor.
Maya Chen: updated to include both `sed` and `perl` variants and a short note.
docs-ci: Preview build queued for PR 4899.
Sam Ortiz: Left a tiny nit on the Dockerfile — replace `node:18` with `node:18-slim` and add an optional alpine example.
Maya Chen: done. Also tightened the deploy steps into 3 bullets for clarity.
Priya (Docs): One more UX nit: can we make the troubleshooting section a tiny collapsible with a 'common 401' entry and exact curl command to debug auth? eg `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/status`
Maya Chen: added the curl check and a note about clock skew errors.
docs-ci: Build passed: docs-ci/preview/4899 ✅ (staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/first-run/preview)
Devon Li: Reviewed and approved — no blockers.
Sam Ortiz: Approved. Thanks for handling the model rename callout, that will save a lot of PR churn. :tada:
Maya Chen: thanks team — merging once the scheduled deploy window opens. Will follow up if anything else crops up.
